items.name: Polynomial.lcoeff
items.type: (R : Type u) [Semiring R] (n : ℕ) : Polynomial R →ₗ[R] R

items.name: Polynomial.lcoeff_apply
items.type: {R : Type u} [Semiring R] (n : ℕ) (f : Polynomial R) : (Polynomial.lcoeff R n) f = f.coeff n

items.name: Polynomial.coeff_list_sum
items.type: {R : Type u} [Semiring R] (l : List (Polynomial R)) (n : ℕ) : l.sum.coeff n = (List.map (⇑(Polynomial.lcoeff R n)) l).sum

items.name: Polynomial.lcoeff_comp_mapAlgHom_eq
items.type: {R : Type u} {A : Type z} {B : Type u_2} [CommSemiring R] [Semiring A] [Semiring B] [Algebra R A] [Algebra R B] (f : A →ₐ[R] B) (n : ℕ) : ↑R (Polynomial.lcoeff B n) ∘ₗ (Polynomial.mapAlgHom f).toLinearMap = f.toLinearMap ∘ₗ ↑R (Polynomial.lcoeff A n)
